name: Cinevista Limited
summary: Cinevista Limited produces and exhibits television programmes, ad commercials, and feature films in India and internationally. The company offers commercial television content in the areas of action, adventure, kids programming, drama, soap, and reality content. It also produces and distributes movies; and produces advertising commercials for various clients and advertisers. In addition, the company provides postproduction services, as well as owns equipment rentals, sound studios, and shooting floors. The company was formerly known as Cinevistaas Limited and changed its name to Cinevista Limited in October 2012. Cinevista Limited was founded in 1982 and is based in Mumbai, India.
